contentHtml:
Blessed,
To have you,
By my side,
In every tides,
In every storms that might.

In every dark night.
For being the light,
That illuminates,
And Eliminates,
The darkness.

Blessed,
To have you,
To understand me,
To understand us,
Not creating any fuss,
Over the things that are,
Just.

Blessed,
To have you,
To hold my hand,
To help me stand,
Through the shifting time,
In every life’s demand.

Blessed,
To have you,
With a heart so kind,
A peaceful mind,
A bond that don’t bind,
A pleasant, refreshing wind.

Blessed,
To have you,
In every way,
Each passing day,
Forever, I hope,
You’ll stay.

Oh it’s fine,
If with time,
Fade fades you,
Shed sheds you,
Take takes you.

I hope you will shine,
As bright as the stars,
As far as the sun,
As warm as heat,
As cool as breeze.

Oh, it’s fine,
If you must go,
As long as you know,
You’ll forever glow,
In my heart’s eternal flow.
